Title: Password Reset
Content: You can reset your password from the account settings page.

Title: Forgot Password
Content: If you forgot your password, you can reset it using the password recovery option.

Title: Change Password
Content: You can change your existing password from your account security settings.

Title: Password Recovery
Content: Users who cannot remember their password can recover their account using the password recovery process.

Title: Change Email
Content: You can change your email address from your profile settings.

Title: Update Email Address
Content: Your registered email address can be updated from the account profile page.

Title: Email Verification
Content: After changing your email address, you may need to verify the new email.

Title: Apply for Leave
Content: Employees can apply for annual leave using the leave management system.

Title: Annual Leave
Content: Annual leave requests should be submitted through the employee leave portal.

Title: Sick Leave
Content: Employees can submit sick leave requests through the leave management system.

Title: Leave Approval
Content: Employees can check whether their leave request has been approved from the leave management system.

Title: Leave Balance
Content: Your remaining annual leave balance can be viewed from the employee portal.

Title: Salary Information
Content: Employees can view their salary information from the payroll system.

Title: Salary Slip
Content: Monthly salary slips are available through the employee payroll portal.

Title: Payroll Date
Content: Employee salaries are processed and deposited according to the monthly payroll schedule.

Title: Salary Deduction
Content: Details about salary deductions can be found on your monthly salary statement.

Title: Order Tracking
Content: You can track your order from the order history page.

Title: Delivery Status
Content: The current delivery status of your package is available in your order details.

Title: Late Delivery
Content: If your order has not arrived on time, check the latest shipping and delivery information.

Title: Expected Delivery
Content: The estimated delivery date can be found in the order tracking information.

Title: Payment Methods
Content: We accept credit cards, debit cards, and supported online payment methods.

Title: Credit Card Payment
Content: You can pay for your order using a supported credit card.

Title: Payment Failed
Content: If your payment fails, verify your payment details and try the transaction again.

Title: Refund Request
Content: You can request a refund from the order details page.

Title: Money Back
Content: Customers can request their money back for eligible purchases.

Title: Refund Status
Content: You can check the status of your refund from your order history.

Title: Cancel Order
Content: You can cancel an order from the order management page before it is shipped.

Title: Order Cancellation
Content: Customers can request cancellation of an order before the shipping process begins.

Title: Customer Support
Content: You can contact customer support through the help center.

Title: Contact Support
Content: If you need assistance, contact a support representative through the customer service portal.

Title: Support Hours
Content: Customer support is available from 9 AM to 6 PM on business days.

Title: Create Account
Content: You can create a new account by completing the registration form.

Title: User Registration
Content: New users must register an account before they can access the application.

Title: Account Activation
Content: After registration, users must activate their account using the verification email.

Title: Delete Account
Content: You can permanently delete your account from the account settings page.
